items.headline: Singapore Airlines in talks to order at least 50 wide-body jets
items.summary: Singapore Airlines is in early-stage talks with Airbus and Boeing for at least 50 large wide-body jets (Boeing 777X or Airbus A350-1000) to power growth into the 2030s; both sides declined to comment.

items.headline: 221 people under police investigation in Singapore over S$9 million in scams
items.summary: Singapore police are investigating 221 people aged 15-81 over suspected roles in 658+ scam cases involving more than S$9 million in losses, from an operation run 21 May-3 June.

items.headline: Southwest monsoon reaches Kerala, three days later than normal
items.summary: The IMD declared the southwest monsoon onset over Kerala on 4 June, three days after the normal 1 June date; seasonal rainfall forecast at about 90% of the long-period average.

items.headline: RBI holds key interest rate at 5.25% for a third straight meeting
items.summary: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee kept the repo rate at 5.25% with a neutral stance, a third consecutive hold; Governor Sanjay Malhotra cited West Asia tensions, crude prices and the monsoon.

items.headline: Five Eyes alliance warns China is recruiting through fake job ads
items.summary: The US and Five Eyes partners issued a rare joint warning that Chinese military intelligence is using LinkedIn and job platforms to recruit cleared personnel via bogus analyst roles.

items.headline: Israel and Lebanon agree to a conditional ceasefire; Hezbollah rejects it
items.summary: Israel and Lebanon agreed to a US-brokered ceasefire conditioned on Hezbollah halting attacks and withdrawing south of the Litani; Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem rejected it and strikes continued.

items.headline: US House passes Russia sanctions and Ukraine aid bill, defying Trump
items.summary: The US House passed new sanctions on Russian oil and gas plus fresh Ukraine aid, with 18 Republicans breaking from Trump; the bill faces an uncertain Senate.

items.headline: Apple's WWDC opens June 8 with a Gemini-powered Siri revamp expected
items.summary: Apple's WWDC begins 8 June with a long-delayed Siri overhaul expected to headline alongside iOS 27; the new Siri is reported to use a custom model built with Google's Gemini team.

items.headline: Broadcom shares drop despite surging AI chip revenue
items.summary: Broadcom posted quarterly revenue of about $22.2B (up 48%) with AI semiconductor revenue up ~143% to $10.8B; shares fell sharply after CEO Hock Tan kept the full-year AI target above $100B unchanged.

items.headline: Andreeva beats Kostyuk to reach her first French Open final
items.summary: Mirra Andreeva, 19, beat Marta Kostyuk 6-1, 6-3 to reach her first Grand Slam final at Roland Garros; she faces unseeded qualifier Maja Chwalinska on Saturday.

items.headline: French Open men's title left wide open after Sinner, Alcaraz and Djokovic exits
items.summary: With Alcaraz withdrawn (wrist) and Sinner and Djokovic out early, the men's semifinals feature Zverev, Jakub Mensik and the all-Italian Cobolli-Arnaldi pairing; Zverev is the highest-ranked man left.

fun_fact.headline: An octopus has three hearts and blue, copper-based blood.
fun_fact.body: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood. Two branchial hearts pump blood through the gills, while a third systemic heart drives it around the body - and that systemic heart actually stops beating when the animal swims, which is one reason octopuses prefer to crawl. The blue colour comes from hemocyanin, a copper-based molecule that carries oxygen well in cold, low-oxygen water.

puzzle.title: The Midnight Bridge
puzzle.body: Four travellers must cross a rickety rope bridge at night with a single flashlight. The bridge holds at most two people at a time, and whoever crosses must carry the flashlight, so it has to be walked back for the others. The four need 1, 2, 5, and 10 minutes to cross; when two cross together they move at the slower one's pace. What is the least total time for all four to get across?
puzzle.approach: Pair the two slowest walkers so the longest crossing happens only once.
puzzle.answer: 17 minutes. Send the 1 and 2 across (2), the 1 returns (1), the 5 and 10 cross together (10), the 2 returns (2), then the 1 and 2 cross again (2): total 17 minutes.
